name: learns category signal and gives unseen test categories no learned one-hot column
input: balanced labels with all numeric values equal
test:
train = [
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'art', 'click': 0},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'art', 'click': 0},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'books', 'click': 1},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'books', 'click': 1},
]
test = [
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'art'},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'books'},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 0, 'current_post_category': 'games'},
]
low, high, unseen = predict_click_probabilities(train, test)
assert 0.0 <= low <= 1.0 and 0.0 <= high <= 1.0 and 0.0 <= unseen <= 1.0
assert low < 0.35
assert high > 0.65
assert 0.35 < unseen < 0.65

name: normalizes numeric fields from training data without mutating records
input: one category with a separable first numeric feature
test:
train = [
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 2, 'current_post_category': 'news', 'click': 0},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 1, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 2, 'current_post_category': 'news', 'click': 0},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 9, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 2, 'current_post_category': 'news', 'click': 1},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 10, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 2, 'current_post_category': 'news', 'click': 1},
]
test = [
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 0, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 2, 'current_post_category': 'news'},
    {'hours_spent_reading_a': 10, 'hours_spent_reading_b': 2, 'hours_spent_reading_c': 2, 'current_post_category': 'news'},
]
train_before = [row.copy() for row in train]
test_before = [row.copy() for row in test]
low, high = predict_click_probabilities(train, test)
assert low < 0.25
assert high > 0.75
assert train == train_before
assert test == test_before
